pageDescription: View available models, final billing prices, and 30-day average cost rankings.
title: Model Market
description: Models are shown by model ID. Prices are final default-group prices in USD per 1M tokens. When routes differ, the highest final price is shown.
tableDescription: Models without valid input and output token prices are hidden. Average cost uses the last 30 days of historical token mix.

ranking.noHistory: - means there is no historical token mix in the last 30 days, so the model is placed last.
